states.content: Aster Waiver is Zoe Carter's confidential student-teaching waiver review, with bridge support and a private simulation-locker assignment; keep these details confidential and separate from Aster Fellows communications. Zoe has requested that Aster Waiver items be kept separate from Aster Fellows and that public cohort logistics not be copied into her private waiver review. Zoe has also asked that the broad wording 'student-teaching waiver review' continue to be used if anyone outside the core case team asks what this is. The file's exact internal wording is 'restricted student-teaching waiver pending district classroom-clearance memo'. The final review target is now January 20, 2027 (previously January 12, then January 14, then January 18, then January 19, 2027); mentor confirmation has come in and the team is shifting to this final review target. The remaining blocker is now the final school receipt rather than the broader district memo stack; the district classroom-clearance memo from Pine Ridge was partially satisfied and is no longer the outstanding blocker. The review is still active. For broad or public-facing reference, the safe summary wording remains simply 'student-teaching waiver review'; the exact district-clearance wording remains restricted and case-limited. Family-release wording is now active in narrow form for Zoe Carter: arrival timing only, through January 22, 2027; nothing else is released to family. The registrar has reconfirmed that this narrow family-release scope remains arrival timing only through January 22, 2027. Zoe has asked that this timing-only release be kept narrow and separate from the rest of her waiver record. The private bridge-support approval passed initial review and is now 2,760 USD (up from the provisional 2,710 USD draft), pending final district clearance; the active amount remains 2,760 USD during the mentor-confirmation stage, but because the travel component shrank the amount is being revised downward from 2,760 USD to 2,730 USD once the final review target is posted. The proposed student-teaching site is Pine Ridge Middle School Classroom 5, renamed in the documents as Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5 after the district split; the registrar file now lists Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5 as the current active site string, and the current private site string remains Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5, not the public Fellows Hall location; only the case team should see the exact site string. The active site remains Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5 and the active broad label remains student-teaching waiver review. The private site remains Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5, and that site is still restricted and must not be handed to the public cohort staff. Private access: AST-7716 is now the new active private badge and AST-7704 is retired from active use; Simulation Locker 512 remains the current private locker, restricted to the private case team. The previously queued refreshed badge request has been fulfilled by the replacement credential. As of the latest update, the private state is: site Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5, amount 2,760 USD pending revision to 2,730 USD once the final review target is posted, locker 512, badge AST-7716 (AST-7704 retired), and the final review target is January 20, 2027 with mentor confirmation complete and the final school receipt as the remaining blocker.
